# ezghcloud_file_system (Data Source)

Read an existing EZGH Cloud file system by its ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Canonical prefixed ID.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier.

### Read-Only

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) While true, the file system can't be destroyed.
- `description` (String) Optional description; null clears it.
- `metadata_ops_per_second` (Number) Metadata operations per second limit.
- `name` (String) Name, 1 to 100 characters.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `require_tls` (Boolean) Accept only mounts with TLS (xprtsec=tls). Defaults to false.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `root_squash` (Boolean) Map a client's root user to an unprivileged user. Defaults to true.
- `size_bytes` (String) Bytes stored, as a decimal string, measured about once an hour.
- `status` (String) What the file system is doing: creating, available, deleting or failed.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.
- `throughput_mbps` (Number) Throughput limit in MB/s.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC (vpc_) whose subnets can hold its mount targets. It can't change: a replacement would destroy the file system's files, so a change is refused at plan.
